per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: APD6 AP06555 is linked to the paper. Literature identity is verified; the sequence/activity row remains source_conflict because APD6 overstates Anti-Gram- breadth and includes an unsupported disulfide annotation while primary evidence supports E. coli/S. cerevisiae activity and a P. syringae negative result.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: The paper has no MIC/MBC/toxicity table, but Fig. 3/methods/results provide valid OD600 growth assay evidence for CFEM10 at 8 uM; three target-specific activity/no-effect records replace the empty scaffold without inventing exact plotted OD values.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Activity evidence is separated from mechanism. The paper explicitly leaves mode of action unresolved, so mechanism claims are bounded to activity assay, speculative discussion context, and cfem10 phenotype association.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Fig. 3 provides plotted OD600 curves and text provides p/time statements, but local XML/PDF/supplement text lacks exact numeric point tables.
APD6 Anti-Gram- category is constrained by primary P. syringae no-effect result.
APD6 3S=S annotation is not explicitly assigned in primary extracted source.
Primary paper discusses possible antimicrobial mechanisms but states deeper investigation is required.
